item.title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
item.description:
Title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
Genre: Casual , Indie , RPG
Developer: Akabaka
Publisher: Black Lantern Collective
Franchise: Black Lantern Collective
Release Date: Aug 31, 2026




About This Game

Eldritch gods. Cosmic horrors. Things beyond our understanding.

To merely gaze upon their form is to abandon all hope.

Or so they say. I've never seen anything I haven't been able to understand and explain clearly.

Until she crash-landed in my living room.

Romance A Comet

A comet has crash-landed in the middle of your living room! You feel its sinister pull, begging you to feed it… Against your better judgement, you give in to Hheily, a sentient comet who can shapeshift into anything– including a hot babe!

Though she may have a gentle nature, she hasn’t come to your planet by accident. What are you willing to sacrifice to win a kiss from the steamiest chick this side of the galaxy?

Fend Off Uninvited Guests

You’re not the only one who feels Hheily’s call: plants grow wild, colors around you intensify, and animals mutate. Her presence soon draws unwanted visitors that are desperate to feel the heat of her flame– at any cost. Worse yet, something malevolent from beyond space and time has followed her trail, lurking in the encroaching darkness.

Save The World

Left without the energy to sustain herself, Hheily asks you to feed her flame and save the planet. But are you up to the task of blazing Hheily back to full strength before her fire is snuffed out? Can you win the heart of the girl who's shown you that reality is more than meets the eye?

Features

  • Gripping story of lovecraftian horror, comedy, and romance, based on H.P. Lovecraft’s The Color out of Space and Clark Ashton Smith’s The City of the Singing Flame

  • Solve colorful puzzles and discover multiple endings based on your actions

  • Experience thousands of lines of fully-voiced, story-rich dialogue

  • Take in lovingly hand-crafted music and artwork made in the classic style of old-school anime and visual novels

  • The apartment where it all started– now re-imagined in 360-degree, hand-drawn 2D environments

  • We really, really promise there's no horror in this one

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Sucker for Love: Crush Landing engages with adult themes and some amounts of comically disturbing body horror. However, the game does not feature any explicit content.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM

item.title: Breathedge 2
item.description:
Title: Breathedge 2
Genre: Action , RPG , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: RedRuins Softworks
Publisher: HypeTrain Digital
Franchise: HypeTrain Digital
Release Date: Aug 31, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 31, 2026




About This Game

Breathedge 2 is a humorous survival adventure set in space, following an ordinary Man and his perfectly ordinary space problems. It’s a direct sequel to Breathedge, but don’t worry if you never played the first game: everything will be equally confusing to Breathedge veterans and complete newcomers alike.

The Breathedge Corporation unexpectedly started a galaxy-wide war, built an enormous army of Coffinbots, and attacked the largest human settlements. The Man and his faithful companion, an AI living inside his spacesuit, accidentally derailed the Corporation’s plans for a swift takeover and instantly became the number-one target of every hostile Coffinbot out there. Apparently, fate still wasn’t satisfied. Having barely survived, our heroes suddenly find themselves under attack by their own allies.

Who attacked whom? Who is Babe? Why does the Man need a Chicken? Where were we even going? And what are we supposed to do with all this duct tape? Figuring that out is now your problem.

EXPLORE

Breathedge 2 is a story-driven adventure where exploring the world is a major part of the experience. Along the way, you’ll get to know the Man and his crew, learn more about life on the distant fringes of inhabited space, meet new characters, and gradually untangle the forces carving up the galaxy between them.

Explore abandoned stations, ruined settlements, shipwrecks, and plenty of places no reasonable person would ever think of entering. Discover other people’s stories, strange devices, useful junk, and completely useless one-of-a-kind treasures. Some discoveries will be funny, others strange or unsettling, and a few may help you understand what is actually going on and what part you have to play in it.

SURVIVE

Hunted from every direction, the heroes of Breathedge 2 are forced to survive in some of the harshest conditions on the fringes of inhabited space. There are no 24-hour stores or banana smoothies out here, but there is an ocean of duct tape, tons of wreckage, and the Man’s remarkably capable hands, ready to turn all that garbage into surprisingly useful contraptions.

Learn new blueprints, craft tools and equipment, and upgrade both your gear and your spacesuit. Repair and dismantle machinery, gather resources, find ways into inaccessible places, and venture farther and farther from anything resembling safety. Out in open space, you’ll need to keep an eye on your oxygen, temperature, and various other little details capable of bringing your adventure to a premature end. Occasionally, you’ll also have to fight, run away, and shove aside the bodies of less fortunate astronauts.

EARLY ACCESS

Breathedge 2 is currently in Early Access and is still actively being developed. At the start of Early Access, the game includes its first major story chapter, a large area to explore, and its core gameplay systems. The story is not yet complete, parts of the world are still inaccessible, and some systems will continue to grow and evolve throughout development.

During Early Access, we plan to release major updates that continue the story and add new areas, mechanics, characters, items, and other features. At the same time, we may continue refining existing content, balance, UI, performance, and fixing issues as they are discovered.

Player feedback is an important part of this process. We’re incredibly grateful for your support and for all the comments that give us both inspiration and a fresh perspective on the game. Please keep sharing your feedback with us wherever you can. It helps us make Breathedge 2 even better.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game contains sexually suggestive content in the context of adult comedy.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1660 6GB / AMD RX 5500 XT 6GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 15 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-13700 / AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVidia Geforce RTX 3070 8GB / AMD RX 6700 XT 8GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 15 GB available space

item.title: The Adventurers
item.description:
Title: The Adventurers
Genre: Indie , RPG , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Eternal Vigilance Entertainment
Publisher: Eternal Vigilance Entertainment
Release Date: Aug 31, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 11, 2024




About This Game

The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a rich, high-fantasy world inspired by classic tabletop role-playing games like Dungeons & Dragons. Lead a diverse party of adventurers as they explore an ever-changing world, engage in strategic combat, and manage the complexities of adventuring life. Take on costly quests, battle mythical creatures, and discover many wonders, as you make a name for yourself in a world filled with opportunities and dangers.

Turn-Based Tactical Combat

Master the art of strategy by harnessing the unique abilities, spells, and skills of your adventurers. Outthink your enemies by using the terrain to your advantage. As the world evolves, so too must your tactics; adapt your strategies and fine-tune your party composition to face increasingly dangerous threats. Every encounter demands sharp thinking, clever planning, and the perfect blend of power and precision to conquer even the mightiest adversaries.

Your Epic Saga Is Waiting To Be Written

Venture into a dynamic world where every journey holds new surprises. Caravans brave perilous roads, desperately hoping to evade ruthless raiders, while dense forests and towering mountains hide both mythical creatures and untold dangers. Discover ancient ruins brimming with forgotten relics and bustling cities alive with intrigue, where secrets wait to be unearthed.

Embark on quests that range from hunting down ferocious beasts and defending vulnerable villages to delving into shadowy conspiracies that could shake the realm. Each quest presents fresh challenges and rich rewards, pushing you closer to legendary status with every choice you make.

Become Legends

Forge your ultimate team of heroes by recruiting adventurers with distinct classes and powerful skills. As they grow stronger, unlock devastating abilities that can turn the tide of battle. Shape your party's strategy by customizing each character’s talents and attributes to craft a perfect blend of power and synergy. Keep your team in top form by managing their morale, health, and stamina—because every decision could mean the difference between victory and defeat as you prepare for thrilling adventures ahead.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Currently uses an AI narrator for accessibility for event related text while in early access in hopes to get a full voice actor on release.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE2 instructions, or any x86_64 CPU
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support
    • Storage: 800 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more
    • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support
    • Storage: 800 MB available space

item.title: Broken Arrow: Russian Guard
item.description:
Title: Broken Arrow: Russian Guard
Genre: Strategy
Developer: Steel Balalaika
Publisher: Slitherine Ltd.
Franchise: Broken Arrow
Release Date: Aug 31, 2026




About This Content

As the conflict escalates, a new Russian specialization becomes available. Combining experienced infantry, modern artillery, advanced air defense systems, and massed armored vehicles, the Internal Troops expand the Russian arsenal with powerful new tactical options.

Take command of a brand-new force across two new maps and two dedicated scenarios.

Russian Guard DLC includes:

  • A new Russian Guard specialisation for the Russian faction

  • 8 infantry squads with 20 unique weapon loadouts

  • 31 new ground and air units

  • 2 new maps: Daugavpils and Coal Mountain

  • 2 new scenarios featuring the Russian Guard

  • A new AI army for Skirmish mode

  • A new hangar theme

A new Russian specialization

The Russian Guard combines elite security formations, reserve infantry, armored vehicles, and powerful support assets into a versatile fighting force capable of adapting to a wide range of battlefield roles.

Deploy Rosgvardiya , BARS , Reservists , Spetsnaz Alpha , FSB Snipers , Border Guards , and Spetsnaz Vympel , supported by reconnaissance vehicles, armored transports, heavy artillery, and modern air defense systems.

Filling The Ranks

Expand your battlegroup with an extensive arsenal of reservist Russian equipment, with some modern surprises.

Out mass the enemy by pressing endless T-62 and T-72A tanks back into service, alongside Tigr , BPM-97 Vystrel , Typhoon-K , and the unmanned Uran-9 .

Deliver devastating fire support with the 2S43 Malva , 9K512 Uragan-1M , 9K58 Kama , and TOS-2 Tosochka , while protecting your forces with layered air defense systems including the Pantsir-S1 , Tor-M1-2U , S-400 Triumf , and Tigr Gibka .

Support your operations with helicopters such as the Ka-50 Black Shark , Ka-60 Kasatka , and Mi-8AMTSh-VN , or flood the skies with the MiG-31BM , MiG-31K , and Yak-130 , while carefully managing assets such as the Tu-95 , An-26 , and the stealth S-70 Okhotnik .

New battlefields

Fight across two new locations designed for distinct tactical challenges.

  • Daugavpils – Dense urban combat across a strategic border city.

  • Coal Mountain – An elevated industrial stronghold where artillery positions dominate the battlefield.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 x64
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 (4* 3400) / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G (4 * 3500)
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 (4096 MB) / Radeon RX 570 (4096 MB)
    • Storage: 85 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 x64
    • Processor: Intel Core i9-9900k (8 * 3600) / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D (8 * 3400)
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3080 (10240 MB) / Radeon RX 6800 XT (16384 MB)
    • Storage: 85 GB available space

item.title: ZENONIA 1
item.description:
Title: ZENONIA 1
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Com2us Holdings , CFK Co., Ltd.
Publisher: Com2us Holdings
Release Date: Aug 31, 2026




About This Game

Where It All Began

Before smartphones. Before app stores.

ZENONIA set the foundation for mobile RPGs.

Now, this iconic action RPG returns in its original form—refined for modern platforms.

A Classic, Reimagined

Bringing back the original charm

while adapting seamlessly to today’s platforms.

Whether you're here for nostalgia

or a brand-new adventure—

ZENONIA is ready.

Classic RPG, Timeless Depth

Choose your path from three distinct classes:

Warrior – Balanced and resilient

Paladin – Defensive and reliable

Assassin – Fast and lethal

Customize your stats and gear

to build a playstyle that’s truly yours.

A Journey Driven by Choice

In a world where light and darkness collide,

every decision matters.

Unfold a rich story filled with unexpected events,

and shape your path between good and evil.

Endless Progression

- Hundreds of items across multiple tiers

- Deep systems combining skills, gear, and character growth

There is always more to discover.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: i3 6100
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: i5-12400
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1660
